item: 1 FieldNode enclosure with ports and antenna
spec: FieldNode standard: light grey polycarbonate enclosure 150 x 90 x 200 mm with gasketed lid and ePTFE vent (IP65), two M16 glands, two M12 5-pin sensor ports, sub-GHz whip antenna, printed ASA internal plate (FieldNode BOM lines 1 to 3 and 9 to 11)
supplier: FieldNode project; enclosure from a Fibox, Hammond or Bud class maker via an electrical distributor; connectors from an industrial connector distributor
notes: Indicative; sum of the FieldNode TRL 3 BOM lines it replaces ($18 + $0 + $3 + $10 + $12 + $4)

spec: FieldNode power board (1S LiFePO4 MPPT charger with NTC lockout, protection, fuel gauge, switched rails) and STM32WL-class LoRaWAN controller (FieldNode BOM lines 7 and 8); standard 6 W charger setting; also runs the fixed-point tracker (CBC-DDR-002)
supplier: FieldNode project; ICs from an electronics distributor (DigiKey or Mouser class); module from RAKwireless or Seeed Studio

spec: 32700 LiFePO4, 3.2 V, 6 Ah (about 19 Wh), charge 0 to 45 C; holder with 5 A fuse and 10 k NTC, as FieldNode BOM line 6
supplier: Battery distributor (cell maker that publishes a datasheet)
notes: Indicative; FieldNode standard single cell (CBC-DDR-002; the second cell belongs to the ESP32-S3 fallback only)

spec: 6 W monocrystalline, 9 V class (Vmp about 9 V at 25 C), about 290 x 200 x 17 mm, with 1 m lead (FieldNode BOM line 4)
notes: Indicative; FieldNode standard panel (CBC-DDR-002); the 20 W panel belongs to the ESP32-S3 fallback only

spec: Aluminium sleeve 120 mm long over the pole top with cap and three M10 set screws, 42.4 x 3.0 mm post 150 mm, hinge plate 140 x 160 x 5 mm at 35 degrees
supplier: Local fabricator from aluminium stockist tube and plate
notes: Indicative material and fabrication cost; fits poles with a free top only

spec: Set: four 12 mm stainless band clamps for 60 to 140 mm poles with rubber liners (two for the enclosure, two for the arm) and an aluminium saddle plate 160 x 300 x 4 mm carrying the FieldNode enclosure
notes: Indicative; FieldNode's V-block kit seats 40 to 60 mm poles only

spec: 40 x 40 x 2 mm 6063 aluminium square tube about 510 mm, welded or bolted to a 6 x 90 x 160 mm saddle plate
supplier: Local make from metal stockist tube and plate

spec: 3D-printed ASA shell 110 x 90 x 70 mm with 150 x 120 mm sun hood and gasket, open underneath for the window; tilted 7.5 degrees toward the road
supplier: Local print (ASA filament from a 3D printing supplier)

spec: 0.5 mm HDPE film, about 100 x 80 mm, unpigmented, clamped with a gasket
notes: Indicative; transmission estimated at 0.75 in CBC-CAL-001 D1 and to be measured

spec: MLX90640 class, 32 x 24 px, 110 x 75 degree lens (BAB type), on an I2C breakout; mounted with its 110 degree axis across the street
supplier: Electronics distributor or maker-board retailer (Adafruit or SparkFun class)
notes: Indicative; read over I2C by the FieldNode STM32WL (CBC-DDR-002); mmWave radar kept as the hot-climate variant (DDR-001 D2, DDR-002)

spec: M12 5-pin A-coded moulded cable about 2 m, IP67, FieldNode sensor port pinout with I2C and 3.3 V (to agree with FieldNode)
notes: Indicative; length set by the model route (enclosure port to head)

spec: Aluminium plate 150 x 200 x 2 mm, UV-stable print: what is counted, that no images are kept, and a link to this repository
notes: Indicative; public notice adopted for TRL 3 (DDR-001 D7)

spec: FieldNode hardware set (standoffs, screws, wire, ferrules, blanking plug, desiccant) plus stainless fasteners, two safety lanyards, UV-stable cable ties and tape; calibration jumper link for the FieldNode service header
notes: Indicative; FieldNode $6 plus $6 for the pole mount; no exploded-view callout
